title: Crispy Gnocchi With Spinach and Feta
description: A bright, herb-filled gnocchi dish inspired by spanakopita, with crispy gnocchi, fresh spinach, feta, and lemon.

steps.instruction: Place spinach in a large bowl. Add half the feta, juice of half the lemon, 1 tablespoon olive oil, and a pinch of salt. Massage until softened.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add 2 tablespoons olive oil.
Add gnocchi and cook for 8–10 minutes, tossing occasionally, until golden and crispy.
Let gnocchi cool for 5 minutes to crisp further.
Add gnocchi to the spinach along with red pepper flakes, scallions, dill, and mint.
Drizzle with remaining olive oil and add remaining feta.
Squeeze remaining lemon juice over the dish and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve.
